name: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Cook rice and let it cool completely.
Heat oil in a pan and saute garlic and onion.
Add chopped vegetables and stir-fry on high heat.
Add soy sauce, salt and pepper.
Add cooled rice and mix well.
Garnish with spring onion and serve hot.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Make a smooth paste of onion, tomato, ginger, garlic and cashew.
Heat butter and cook the paste until oil separates.
Add spice powders and salt.
Add water or milk to adjust consistency.
Add paneer cubes and cream.
Simmer for 5 minutes and serve.

name: Egg Bhurji
steps: Heat oil and saute onion until golden.
Add tomato and green chilli and cook until soft.
Add turmeric, chilli powder and salt.
Pour beaten eggs and scramble on medium heat.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve.

name: Pasta Arrabbiata
steps: Boil pasta until al dente.
Heat olive oil and saute garlic and chilli.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook into a sauce.
Season with salt and pepper.
Toss the pasta in the sauce.
Garnish with basil and serve.

name: Chicken Curry
steps: Heat oil and saute onion until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook.
Add tomatoes and spice powders.
Add chicken pieces and cook on high heat.
Add water and simmer until chicken is tender.
Finish with garam masala and coriander leaves.

name: Aloo Paratha
steps: Boil and mash potatoes. Mix with onion, chilli, coriander and salt.
Make soft dough with wheat flour and water.
Stuff the potato mixture into dough balls.
Roll into parathas and cook on tawa with oil/butter.
Serve hot with curd or pickle.

name: Tomato Soup
steps: Boil tomatoes and onion until soft.
Blend into a smooth puree.
Heat butter and saute garlic.
Add the puree, salt, pepper and sugar.
Simmer and finish with cream.

name: Masala Dosa
steps: Prepare fermented dosa batter from rice and urad dal.
Make potato masala with onion, spices and curry leaves.
Spread batter on hot tawa to make thin dosa.
Place potato filling inside and fold.
Serve with chutney and sambar.

name: Vegetable Maggi
steps: Heat oil and saute onion and vegetables.
Add water and bring to boil.
Add maggi noodles and tastemaker.
Cook until water is absorbed.
Serve hot.

name: Dal Tadka
steps: Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric and salt.
Prepare tadka with ghee, cumin, mustard, garlic and chilli.
Add onion and tomato to the tadka.
Mix tadka into the cooked dal.
Garnish with coriander leaves.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
steps: Butter the bread slices.
Place cheese between two slices.
Grill on tawa or sandwich maker until golden.
Sprinkle black pepper and serve.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Saute onion, ginger and garlic.
Add tomatoes and spice powders.
Add boiled chickpeas and some water.
Simmer until gravy thickens.
Finish with garam masala.

name: Omelette
steps: Beat eggs with salt and pepper.
Add chopped onion, chilli and coriander.
Heat oil in a pan.
Pour the mixture and cook both sides.
Serve hot.

name: Jeera Rice
steps: Wash and soak basmati rice.
Heat ghee and crackle cumin seeds and bay leaf.
Add rice and salt.
Add water and cook until done.
Fluff and serve.

name: Garlic Bread
steps: Mix softened butter with minced garlic, salt and coriander.
Spread the mixture on bread slices.
Toast on tawa or bake until golden.
Serve hot.

name: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch spinach and make a puree.
Saute onion, ginger, garlic and tomato.
Add spinach puree and cook.
Add paneer cubes and cream.
Simmer and serve.

name: Veg Hakka Noodles
steps: Boil noodles and keep aside.
Stir-fry garlic and vegetables on high heat.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Toss the noodles well.
Serve hot.

name: Curd Rice
steps: Mix cooked rice with curd and little milk.
Prepare tempering with mustard, curry leaves, chilli and ginger.
Add tempering to the rice.
Adjust salt and serve chilled or at room temperature.

name: French Toast
steps: Beat egg with milk, sugar and vanilla.
Dip bread slices in the mixture.
Cook on buttered pan until golden on both sides.
Serve with honey or syrup.

name: Lemon Rice
steps: Cook rice and let it cool.
Prepare tempering with mustard, dals, chilli, curry leaves and peanut.
Add turmeric and salt.
Mix with rice and lemon juice.
Serve.
